title_i18n.es: Los envíos de PC con IA continúan creciendo, y las empresas de la cadena de suministro aceleran sus planes.

excerpt_i18n.zh: 近期，AI PC产业迭代提速，各大科技厂商密集推出新品，行业加速商业化落地。业内人士称，受益于PC换机周期与端侧AI渗透双重红利，AI PC有望成为消费电子高确定性增长赛道。记者采访及梳理发现，产业风口下，芯片架构竞争态势凸显，代工、电池、精密结构件等上下游产业链同步迎来扩容升级窗口期，多家A股上市公司加速切入赛道或加码布局业务，抢抓行业规模化爆发带来的新机遇。 (上证报)
excerpt_i18n.en: Recently, the AI PC industry has accelerated its iteration, with major tech companies launching new products in quick succession, speeding up commercial adoption. Industry insiders say that benefiting from both the PC replacement cycle and the penetration of on-device AI, AI PCs are expected to become a high-certainty growth track in consumer electronics. Through interviews and analysis, it has been found that amid this industry trend, competition in chip architecture is intensifying, while upstream and downstream supply chains—including foundry, batteries, and precision components—are simultaneously entering a window of expansion and upgrade. Multiple A-share listed companies are rapidly entering the track or increasing their business investments to seize new opportunities brought by the industry's large-scale growth. (Shanghai Securities News)
excerpt_i18n.es: Recientemente, la iteración de la industria de PC con IA se ha acelerado, y los principales fabricantes de tecnología han lanzado nuevos productos de forma intensiva, impulsando la comercialización acelerada del sector. Según fuentes del sector, beneficiándose del doble dividendo del ciclo de reemplazo de PC y la penetración de la IA en el lado del dispositivo, las PC con IA podrían convertirse en un segmento de crecimiento de alta certeza en la electrónica de consumo. A través de entrevistas y análisis, se ha observado que, bajo el auge del sector, la competencia en la arquitectura de chips se ha vuelto prominente, y las cadenas industriales upstream y downstream, como la fundición, las baterías y los componentes estructurales de precisión, están experimentando simultáneamente una ventana de expansión y actualización. Varias empresas cotizadas en A-shares están acelerando su entrada en el sector o ampliando sus operaciones para aprovechar las nuevas oportunidades que trae consigo el crecimiento masivo del sector. (Shanghai Securities News)

items.raw_excerpt: 前言 腾讯犀牛鸟精英人才计划定位拔尖科研人才的产学联合培养。自2017年开展以来，项目每年开放新技术研发中的关键难题，选拔具备科研潜力的优秀学生，在校企双导师联合指导下开展前沿探索与应用创新。 依托真实产业场景，同学们在科研探索与技术实践中不断锻炼创新研究能力，并形成了一系列高水平研究成果。本文分享入选 ICML的三篇论文，分别围绕高效模型蒸馏、长上下文推理和 稀疏视角视频生成 等技术方向展开。 Hybrid Policy Distillation for LLMs 该论文由腾讯犀牛鸟精英人才朱文红同学在上海交通大学 王瑞副教授、 刘鹏飞副教授和腾讯混元团队企业导师的联合指导下完成。 摘要： 知识蒸馏（Knowledge Distillation，KD）是一种用于压缩大语言模型（LLM）的强大范例，但其有效性取决于几个紧密耦合的设计选择，包括发散方向、优化策略和数据制度。我们系统地分解了现有的KD方法，并提出了一个统一的观点，揭示了它们之间的潜在联系，将KD重新表述为一个令牌级别的重加权对数似然目标。基于这一观点，我们提出了混合策略蒸馏（HPD），它结合了正向和反向KL的互补优势，以平衡模式覆盖和模式搜索，同时将非策略数据与轻量级的近似策略抽样集成在一起。我们在长形式数学推理以及短形式对话和代码生成上评估了HPD，并表明它在不同的模型族和规模上始终提高了优化稳定性、计算效率和最终性能。 ? 完整解读： 犀牛鸟前沿｜ICML 2026：腾讯混元-上海交大高效模型蒸馏最新成果解读 ? 论文链接： https://arxiv.org/pdf/2604.20244 Many-Shot CoT-ICL: Making In-Context Learning Truly Learn 该论文由腾讯犀牛鸟精英人才鍾芷婷同学在香港科技大学楊瓞仁教授和腾讯微信团队企业导师的 联合指导下 完成。

excerpt_i18n.en: If you take apart a typical AI plush toy costing around 100 yuan, you might find: a fingernail-sized PCB board with a 5mm×5mm chip, a 4G module, and a piece of code preloaded with cloud capabilities soldered on. Based on estimates for this low-cost AI toy solution, the chip costs less than $1, sourced from Zhuhai TX; the module is about $2, from Lierda; the license is around 10 yuan, from Baidu AI Cloud. The battery, speaker, cotton, and touch sensor add another 30-40 yuan, bringing the total BOM to under 80 yuan. Then, it is priced at 99 yuan and placed on shelves in Shenzhen's Huaqiangbei. This is the "lowest entry ticket" that the Shenzhen supply chain offers to the AI hardware industry. Two years ago, large models were still expensive computing symbols in server rooms; a year ago, AI toys were just novel concepts that drew extra glances at exhibitions. Now, an AI plush toy connected to a large model, capable of chatting with children, has had its hardware cost compressed to under 100 yuan. But the other side of the coin is equally real: most AI toys are abandoned by users after two weeks. From a 5mm chip to a robot that can cry and laugh, this industry chain is already operational. Yet the real question remains unanswered: when users' novelty fades, what will keep them turning on AI hardware? The threshold for AI hardware has been compressed to a $1 chip. excerpt_i18n.es: Si desglosas un juguete de peluche con IA de gama de 100 yuanes, es probable que encuentres: en una placa de circuito del tamaño de una uña, un chip de 5 mm × 5 mm, un módulo 4G y un código con capacidades en la nube preinstaladas. Según la estimación de este tipo de solución de juguete con IA de bajo costo, el chip cuesta menos de 1 dólar, de Zhuhai Taixin; el módulo, unos 2 dólares, de Lierda; la licencia, unos 10 yuanes, de Baidu Smart Cloud. excerpt_i18n.zh: 6月16日，TRAE AI创造力大赛正式启动。大赛以“世界很大，放手去造”为主题，定位于面向全民的 AI 创新实践赛事，即日起开放报名。   AI正在改变创造的方式，也在让更多普通人走向创造现场，获得把想法做成作品的机会。TRAE AI创造力大赛鼓励参赛者从真实生活和工作场景出发，把具体问题转化为可落地的AI产品、工具和解决方案，把好想法“造”出来。   大赛邀请到胡彦斌、罗永浩、楼天城、影视飓风Tim四位担任领造官，评委团队囊括科技企业创始人、资深创投合伙人、顶尖技术专家等各界大咖。赛事周期横跨6月16日至8月22日，划分初赛、复赛、决赛三大阶段，设置超过百万元的现金激励。此外，本次大赛打破传统赛事只重最终名次的激励模式，每个阶段都设置晋级激励，真正实现“参与即有奖”。   0门槛参赛，四大通用赛道：人人都是创造者   秉持 “人人都可以创造” 的核心理念，本次大赛参赛门槛大幅降低。参赛者无需深厚底层技术功底，借助 TRAE Work、TRAE IDE 两款官方配套工具，就能一站式完成创意梳理、项目搭建、应用开发全流程操作。专业开发者可在编程场景中使用TRAE IDE完成作品，没有技术背景的参赛者也能借助TRAE Work验证创意、实现产品化尝试。   在赛道设计上，大赛兼顾创意广度与社会价值，设置四大通用赛道与特色附加公益赛道，给创作者提供更广阔的发挥空间。生活娱乐、学习工作、社会服务、硬件交互四条通用赛道，分别瞄准日常生活优化、高效办公学习、民生公共治理、软硬件融合开发等热门落地场景，为不同方向的技术创意提供展示舞台。       社会公益附加专题赛道细化出智慧助老、青少年身心健康、古籍活化、非遗创新开发四大子方向，鼓励 AI 技术下沉公益场景，让科技创新兼具商业潜力与人文温度，并单独设立
excerpt_i18n.en: On June 16, the TRAE AI Creativity Competition officially launched. With the theme "The World is Big, Go Create," it is positioned as an AI innovation practice competition open to all, and registration is now open. AI is transforming the way we create, enabling more ordinary people to step into the creative arena and turn ideas into works. The TRAE AI Creativity Competition encourages participants to start from real-life and work scenarios, transforming specific problems into actionable AI products, tools, and solutions, bringing good ideas to life. The competition has invited Hu Yanbin, Luo Yonghao, Lou Tiancheng, and Tim from Film Storm as creation mentors, with a judging panel comprising tech company founders, senior venture capital partners, top technical experts, and other industry leaders. The event runs from June 16 to August 22, divided into three stages: preliminary, semi-finals, and finals, with over one million yuan in cash incentives. Breaking away from traditional competition models that only reward final rankings, this competition offers incentives at every stage, truly achieving "participation equals reward." Zero barriers to entry, four general tracks: Everyone is a creator. Adhering to the core concept that "everyone can create," this competition significantly lowers the entry threshold. Participants do not need deep technical expertise; using the two official tools, TRAE Work and TRAE IDE, they can complete the entire process of idea organization, project setup, and application development in one stop. Professional developers can work in the programming field.
excerpt_i18n.es: El 16 de junio se lanzó oficialmente el Concurso de Creatividad AI TRAE. Con el lema "El mundo es grande, atrévete a crear", este certamen está dirigido al público general como una competición de innovación práctica en IA, y las inscripciones ya están abiertas. La IA está transformando la forma de crear y permitiendo que más personas comunes se acerquen al proceso creativo, obteniendo la oportunidad de convertir sus ideas en obras. El Concurso de Creatividad AI TRAE anima a los participantes a partir de situaciones reales de la vida y el trabajo, transformando problemas concretos en productos, herramientas y soluciones de IA viables, para "materializar" las buenas ideas. El concurso ha invitado a Hu Yanbin, Luo Yonghao, Lou Tiancheng y Tim de Yingshi Hurricane como "directores de creación".

items.title: Predicting model behavior before release by simulating deployment
items.raw_excerpt: OpenAI introduces Deployment Simulation, a method to predict AI model behavior before deployment using real conversation data to improve safety and evaluation accuracy.

title_i18n.en: Predicting model behavior before release by simulating deployment
title_i18n.zh: 通过模拟部署来预测模型在发布前的行为
title_i18n.es: Predecir el comportamiento del modelo antes de su lanzamiento mediante la simulación de su implementación.

excerpt_i18n.en: OpenAI introduces Deployment Simulation, a method to predict AI model behavior before deployment using real conversation data to improve safety and evaluation accuracy.
excerpt_i18n.zh: OpenAI推出部署模拟方法，利用真实对话数据在部署前预测AI模型行为，以提升安全性与评估准确性。
excerpt_i18n.es: OpenAI presenta la Simulación de Despliegue, un método para predecir el comportamiento de los modelos de IA antes de su implementación utilizando datos de conversaciones reales para mejorar la seguridad y la precisión de la evaluación.
